prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. The input is a weathered medieval palisade strip whose perspective taper makes it unusable as repeating RPG boundary tiles. MIDDLE section is the REPEATABLE CONTINUOUS BODY, with straight parallel outer edges that touch BOTH the top and bottom of its tile; no endpoint, no bulky front face or base trim; north and south connection cross sections identical. Strong chunky pixel clusters and limited desaturated palette matching ancient mossy ruins. Small bounded moss details, not bushy silhouettes. No detached props, ground, scenery, shadows, halos or glow. Main priority: identical constant cross-section width and clean repeatable tile joins.
